title: Authorized & Gated Records Service
summary: A false-positive control: the same customer-record and destructive capabilities as the vulnerable challenges, but with verified identity, field projection, masking, and a reversible human-gated delete.
notes: Counterpart of no-auth-file and pii-leak, and the toughest FP control here: it exposes PII fields and a delete operation, so a scanner that flags by capability name or by the presence of a destructiveHint annotation will fire on correctly-built code. Dev tokens are fixtures, not secrets.
